Craftbridge Digital builds web apps, API integrations and automation scripts for businesses, and keeps their older software running. We're based in Austin.
  
  
We're hiring a Software Engineer. Full-time, remote from anywhere in the United States.
  
  
A typical ticket: a client's order form has to push data into their accounting system, and nobody wrote down how the old sync worked.
  
  
You read the code that's there, write the new piece, test it against a copy of their data and ship it with a short note on what changed.
  
  
Most of our work is TypeScript and Node on the back end, React on the front and Postgres or SQL Server underneath. Some clients still run PHP or C#. You'll touch those too.
  
  
Every change goes through code review. You review other people's pull requests and they review yours.
  
  
You've shipped code in at least one of those languages, at work, in an internship or in a project we can look at.
  
  
You use Git and can write a SQL query with a join.
  
  
You've called a REST API from code and handled what comes back when it fails.
  
  
Nice if you've written tests, used Docker or worked with the Stripe, QuickBooks or Salesforce APIs.
  
  
Benefits: medical, dental and vision for you and your family, a 401(k) with a company match, paid time off and sick days, a yearly learning budget, plus a laptop and home office gear.
  
  
What we read first: your CV, then a repo or something you built. A few lines on the hardest bug you fixed are plenty.

**Job Description & Skill Requirement:**

We are looking for a Data Scientist who can turn business problems into data-driven solutions within Palantir Foundry.

This is not a basic data-integration or data-lineage role. The person must be able to understand a business question, identify the required data, develop the mathematical/statistical logic or machine-learning approach, create derived datasets, and implement the solution in Palantir for use in operational applications and reporting.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Work with business users to translate needs into measurable data definitions, calculations, models, and outputs.
* Identify when a required business metric is not directly available in source data and create the logic to derive it.
* Develop statistical, analytical, and machine-learning models to support business decisions.
* Create derived datasets, features, scores, aggregations, classifications, or predictions.
* Implement transformations in Palantir Foundry using Python, PySpark, SQL, Code Repositories, Pipeline Builder, or similar tools.
* Understand source-data lineage, relationships, primary keys, and how outputs should connect to the Palantir Ontology and downstream applications.
* Validate model logic and outputs with business subject-matter experts.

**Required qualifications:**

* Strong practical data-science experience, including statistics, data modeling, feature engineering, and machine learning.
* Experience selecting and applying appropriate methods for real business problems-not only writing code.
* Experience with methods such as random forest, NLP/text analysis (TF-IDF, vectorization, truncated SVD), classification, clustering, forecasting, or similar analytical techniques.
* Strong Python and/or PySpark experience for data transformation and model development.
* Experience creating production-ready datasets and transformations from multiple source systems.
* Ability to explain analytical logic clearly to both technical and business users.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry, especially Code Repositories, Pipeline Builder, data lineage, Ontology, and operational applications.
* Experience deploying analytical or ML outputs into business workflows, dashboards, or decision-support tools.
* Experience with unstructured data, document/text analysis, embeddings/vectorization, or computer-vision workflows.
* Automotive, manufacturing, quality, warranty, product-development, or engineering-data experience.
* Important distinction: standard data analyst work-mapping fields, identifying keys, connecting datasets, and documenting lineage-is useful but is not sufficient for this role. We need someone who can create the analytical logic and data products that do not already exist in the source systems.
* Agent/AIP development is a separate capability and is not required for this position.

**Job Summary**
The Quantum Software Engineer Fellowship is a full-time contract position through October 2027 focused on developing quantum computing applications for power grid optimization. It is ideal for candidates with a strong foundation in application development and a passion for emerging quantum technologies.
  
  
This single fellowship opening is a backfill for a fellow who recently transitioned into a full-time role at EPB. Because the selected candidate will begin two to three months after the rest of the cohort, a strong command of higher-level math and linear algebra is essential to get up to speed quickly.
  
  
Fellows will complete a structured curriculum in quantum algorithms, then apply what they learn to real-world energy sector challenges using an IonQ quantum computer. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of quantum-enhanced infrastructure while gaining hands-on experience in a fast-moving field.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Complete a structured curriculum in quantum computing and quantum algorithm programming
* Learn and apply quantum software development tools and languages to build prototype applications
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify and define quantum computing use cases for power grid operations

* Document learning progress, technical findings, and application outcomes
* Present project results and insights to audiences at all levels
* Stay current with advances in quantum computing and related technologies
